lines.zh: 小步快跑，秘界地面在我脚下发颤。
lines.en: Tiny steps, quick steps—the Secret Grove trembles beneath me.

lines.zh: 别看我小，这身甲壳硬得很。
lines.en: Don't let my size fool you; this shell is tough.

lines.zh: 贴着裂缝走，那里最安全。
lines.en: I hug the cracks—that's where it's safest.

lines.zh: 六条腿一起动，谁也追不上。
lines.en: Six legs moving at once—no one keeps up.

lines.zh: 低身潜行，别惊动大东西。
lines.en: Keep low, keep quiet—don't wake the big ones.

lines.zh: 这片秘界地面，我熟得很。
lines.en: I know every inch of this Secret Grove ground.

lines.zh: 钻过石缝，一眨眼就不见。
lines.en: Through the stone gap—gone in a blink.

lines.zh: 甲壳刮过地面，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the ground with a soft rasp.

lines.zh: 巡逻我的小地盘，谁也别乱闯。
lines.en: Patrolling my little patch—no trespassing.

lines.zh: 走快点，趁光还没照到这边。
lines.en: Move fast before the light reaches this side.

lines.zh: 我这么小，踩一脚都难踩中。
lines.en: So small—good luck stepping on me.

lines.zh: 沿着岩壁边缘，绕过去。
lines.en: Along the rock wall's edge, slip around.

lines.zh: 闻到陌生气味，先绕道走。
lines.en: Strange scent—I'll take the long way round.

lines.zh: 细腿飞快倒腾，停不下来。
lines.en: Tiny legs whirring—can't stop now.

lines.zh: 找个更暗的角落继续赶路。
lines.en: Find a darker corner and keep moving.

lines.zh: 别挡道，我可不想撞上你。
lines.en: Out of my way—I'd rather not bump into you.

lines.zh: 缩在石缝里，静静等。
lines.en: Tucked in a stone crack, waiting quietly.

lines.zh: 谁在附近？先别动。
lines.en: Who's nearby? Best stay still.

lines.zh: 甲壳贴着凉石头，挺舒服。
lines.en: Shell against cool stone—quite comfortable.

lines.zh: 这么小，安静才活得久。
lines.en: This small, silence keeps me alive.

lines.zh: 秘界的光怪怪的，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The Secret Grove's light is odd—I don't like it.

lines.zh: 歇一会儿，腿都跑酸了。
lines.en: A short rest—my legs are tired.

lines.zh: 有动静就缩起来，装成石头。
lines.en: Any noise, I curl up and play stone.

lines.zh: 这角落没人来，正合适。
lines.en: No one comes to this corner—perfect.

lines.zh: 触角动了动，探探风向。
lines.en: Antennae twitch, testing the air.

lines.zh: 我不惹事，也别来惹我。
lines.en: I start no trouble—don't start any with me.

lines.zh: 背上的棱角，可不是摆设。
lines.en: The ridges on my back aren't just decoration.

lines.zh: 安静待着，等危险过去。
lines.en: Stay quiet till the danger passes.

lines.zh: 你这么大，想干什么？
lines.en: You're huge—what do you want?

lines.zh: 盯着我干嘛，我又不好吃。
lines.en: Why stare? I'm not worth eating.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我就缩进缝里。
lines.en: Come closer and I'll slip into a crack.

lines.zh: 你踩不到我，我太小了。
lines.en: You can't step on me—I'm too small.

lines.zh: 别拿手抓我，甲壳会刮人。
lines.en: Don't grab me—my shell scrapes.

lines.zh: 你在找Collector Fragments？没门。
lines.en: Looking for Collector Fragments? Not from me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你呢，别乱动。
lines.en: I've got my eye on you—don't move.

lines.zh: 这么大的影子，真吓人。
lines.en: Such a big shadow—frightening.

lines.zh: 你要是不走，我就先溜。
lines.en: If you don't leave, I'll slip away first.

lines.zh: 我们各走各的，行不行？
lines.en: Let's each go our own way—deal?

lines.zh: 疼！甲壳差点裂开。
lines.en: Ouch! My shell nearly cracked.

lines.zh: 谁打我？我这么小也下得去手。
lines.en: Who hit me? Even something this small?

lines.zh: 缩起来，缩起来，别再来一下。
lines.en: Curl up, curl up—no second hit, please.

lines.zh: 腿都麻了，得赶紧躲。
lines.en: My legs went numb—must hide fast.

lines.zh: 你打中我了，算你厉害。
lines.en: You got me—credit where it's due.

lines.zh: 这一下真疼，我要溜了。
lines.en: That really hurt—I'm slipping away.

lines.zh: 壳上留了道印子，记下了。
lines.en: A mark on my shell—noted.

lines.zh: 别追着打，我受不住。
lines.en: Stop chasing and hitting—I can't take it.

lines.zh: 三十六点血，掉得我心慌。
lines.en: Thirty-six health—losing it makes me panic.

lines.zh: 打一下就跑，这才公平。
lines.en: Hit once and run—now that's fair.

lines.zh: 吃的？我不为食物动心，别拿这个逗我。
lines.en: Food? I don't move for food—don't tease me with that.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西引不起我兴趣。
lines.en: What's in your hand doesn't interest me.

lines.zh: 我这么小，可不会被零食骗走。
lines.en: I'm too small to be lured off by snacks.

lines.zh: 别晃了，我只在乎我的石缝。
lines.en: Stop waving that—I only care about my stone cracks.

lines.zh: 拿食物换我的碎片？想得美。
lines.en: Trade food for my fragments? Nice try.

lines.zh: 我不饿，你收起来吧。
lines.en: I'm not hungry—put it away.

lines.zh: 那味道飘过来，我也懒得挪腿。
lines.en: That smell drifts by, and I still won't move a leg.

lines.zh: 诱惑对我没用，我警惕着呢。
lines.en: Temptation doesn't work—I'm on my guard.

lines.zh: 你越晃，我越往后退。
lines.en: The more you wave it, the further I back away.

lines.zh: 省省吧，我只看不吃。
lines.en: Save it—I only look, never take.

lines.zh: 哎哟，撞上你了，快让开。
lines.en: Oof, bumped into you—move aside.

lines.zh: 我这小身板可经不起撞。
lines.en: This tiny body can't take a hit.

lines.zh: 你脚太大了，差点踩到我。
lines.en: Your feet are huge—almost stepped on me.

lines.zh: 别挤，我的甲壳会刮到你。
lines.en: Don't crowd me—my shell will scrape you.

lines.zh: 撞一下没关系，我溜得快。
lines.en: A bump's fine—I dart away fast.

lines.zh: 这地面太挤，我换条路。
lines.en: Too crowded here—I'll take another path.

lines.zh: 碰上大东西，我立刻缩起来。
lines.en: Hit something big—I curl up at once.

lines.zh: 喂，看路，我就在你脚边。
lines.en: Hey, watch your step—I'm right by your feet.

lines.zh: 被撞歪了，重新找方向。
lines.en: Knocked off course—finding my way again.

lines.zh: 别追着撞我，我可会躲。
lines.en: Don't keep bumping me—I know how to dodge.

lines.zh: 这事我不感兴趣，别问了。
lines.en: Not interested in that—stop asking.

lines.zh: 我只想安安静静待着。
lines.en: I just want to sit quietly.

lines.zh: 秘界里危险多，我没这心思。
lines.en: The Secret Grove is dangerous—I've no mind for that.

lines.zh: 个头这么小，顾不上那些。
lines.en: This small, I've no time for that.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我戒备着呢。
lines.en: Keep back—I'm on guard.

lines.zh: 我对这个没兴趣，走开。
lines.en: I'm not into that—go away.

lines.zh: 现在不是时候，我忙着巡逻。
lines.en: Not the time—I'm busy patrolling.

lines.zh: 找别人去吧，我不参与。
lines.en: Find someone else—I'm not joining in.

lines.zh: 我这脾气，独自待着挺好。
lines.en: With my temper, being alone suits me fine.

lines.zh: 免谈，我只关心石缝和碎片。
lines.en: No deal—I only care about cracks and fragments.

lines.zh: 这块Collector Fragment归我了。
lines.en: This Collector Fragment is mine now.

lines.zh: 碎片落到我脚边，正好捡走。
lines.en: A fragment dropped by my feet—perfect to snatch.

lines.zh: 小归小，捡东西可不慢。
lines.en: Small as I am, I'm quick to pick things up.

lines.zh: 藏进石缝，谁也找不着。
lines.en: Hide it in a crack—no one will find it.

lines.zh: 这块亮晶晶的，我要了。
lines.en: This shiny one—I'll take it.

lines.zh: 悄悄收好，别让人看见。
lines.en: Tuck it away quietly—don't let anyone see.

lines.zh: 捡到一块，够我美半天。
lines.en: One fragment found—that'll please me a while.

lines.zh: 碎片是我的收藏，别碰。
lines.en: The fragments are my collection—don't touch.

lines.zh: 用腿夹紧，溜回角落。
lines.en: Clamp it in my legs and scurry to a corner.

lines.zh: 又来一块，我的藏货多了。
lines.en: Another one—my stash is growing.

lines.zh: 盯上你了，别以为我小就好惹。
lines.en: Locked on you—don't think small means harmless.

lines.zh: 从石缝窜出来，我咬你的脚踝。
lines.en: I dart from the crack and bite your ankle.

lines.zh: 个子大又怎样，我照样咬。
lines.en: Big or not, I still bite.

lines.zh: 目标确定，就是你了。
lines.en: Target confirmed—it's you.

lines.zh: 别乱动，我已经瞄上你了。
lines.en: Hold still—I've got my sights on you.

lines.zh: 靠近石缝的，都得挨一下。
lines.en: Anything near my crack gets a nip.

lines.zh: 你挡我路了，先下手为强。
lines.en: You're in my way—I strike first.

lines.zh: 小小的身躯，也能咬出七点伤害。
lines.en: A tiny body can still bite for seven.

lines.zh: 锁定，准备冲过去。
lines.en: Locked on—ready to charge.

lines.zh: 谁让你踩这片地，自找的。
lines.en: You stepped on this ground—your fault.

lines.zh: 别小看秘界的小虫子。
lines.en: Never underestimate a Secret Grove bug.

lines.zh: 盯紧你，别想溜。
lines.en: Eyes on you—no slipping away.

lines.zh: 绕到你脚边，找机会咬。
lines.en: Circling your feet, looking for an opening.

lines.zh: 你转身慢，我跟得上。
lines.en: You turn slowly—I can keep up.

lines.zh: 太小了不好打中我吧？
lines.en: Too small to hit me, aren't I?

lines.zh: 贴着地面游走，等你露出破绽。
lines.en: Skittering low, waiting for a gap.

lines.zh: 别抬脚，我可就在下面。
lines.en: Don't lift that foot—I'm right under it.

lines.zh: 你越急，我越有耐心。
lines.en: The more you rush, the more patient I get.

lines.zh: 我绕着转，找你的空档。
lines.en: Circling around, hunting your blind spot.

lines.zh: 甲壳贴着地，影子都看不清。
lines.en: Shell to the ground—my shadow's hard to see.

lines.zh: 我只有蠹虫那么大，很难戳中。
lines.en: I'm barely silverfish-sized, hard to hit.

lines.zh: 你找不到我的，我太小了。
lines.en: You won't find me—I'm far too small.

lines.zh: 守住这个角度，别让它跑。
lines.en: Hold this angle—don't let it escape.

lines.zh: 等你背对我，我就冲。
lines.en: When your back turns, I charge.

lines.zh: 咬你脚踝，看你跳不跳。
lines.en: A nip at your ankle—see if you jump.

lines.zh: 棱角刮过去，够你疼一下。
lines.en: My ridges rake past—that'll sting.

lines.zh: 小口一咬，七点伤害不轻。
lines.en: One quick bite—seven damage isn't light.

lines.zh: 别乱踩，我可不是好惹的。
lines.en: Don't stomp around—I'm not to be trifled with.

lines.zh: 钻到腿后，狠狠来一下。
lines.en: Dart behind your legs and strike hard.

lines.zh: 贴地一冲，撞完就跑。
lines.en: Charge low, hit, then run.

lines.zh: 你反应不过来，我太小了。
lines.en: You can't react—I'm too small.

lines.zh: 甲壳一顶，让你退半步。
lines.en: A shove of my shell makes you step back.

lines.zh: 咬完缩进缝里，你打不着。
lines.en: Bite, then slip into a crack—can't hit me.

lines.zh: 这一下，记住了吧？
lines.en: That one—remember it?

lines.zh: 从石缝里钻出来，秘界又多一只小麻烦。
lines.en: Out of a stone crack—one more tiny nuisance in the Secret Grove.

lines.zh: 刚孵化，壳还硬邦邦的。
lines.en: Just hatched, shell still stiff.

lines.zh: 这地方的光真刺眼。
lines.en: The light here stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 悄悄地，别让大东西注意到我。
lines.en: Quietly now—don't let the big ones notice me.

lines.zh: 四处看看，找个安全角落。
lines.en: Look around—find a safe corner.

lines.zh: 我来了，这片地归我巡逻。
lines.en: I'm here—this patch is mine to patrol.

lines.zh: 这么小，得先藏好自己。
lines.en: This small, I'd better hide first.

lines.zh: 脚下碎石哗啦一响，我出生了。
lines.en: Gravel rattles—and here I am.

lines.zh: 秘界的气味，熟悉又陌生。
lines.en: The Secret Grove's scent—familiar and strange.

lines.zh: 腿还软，先挪几步试试。
lines.en: Legs still shaky—let me try a few steps.

lines.zh: 烫！壳都快烧红了。
lines.en: Hot! My shell's nearly glowing red.

lines.zh: 摔下来，腿都震麻了。
lines.en: Fell hard—my legs are numb from the shock.

lines.zh: 水里喘不上气，快爬出去。
lines.en: Can't breathe underwater—climbing out fast.

lines.zh: 轰一声，我被掀翻了。
lines.en: A boom—I've been blown off my feet.

lines.zh: 有东西飞过来，扎进壳缝了。
lines.en: Something flew in and lodged between my shell plates.

lines.zh: 这光怪怪的，钻进甲壳里了。
lines.en: Strange light—it seeped into my shell.

lines.zh: 饿得腿发软，走不动了。
lines.en: So hungry my legs wobble—can't walk.

lines.zh: 我这么小，一记雷就够麻。
lines.en: I am so small that one bolt numbs me out.

lines.zh: 秘界的小虫，掉进虚空了。
lines.en: A tiny bug of the Secret Realm falls into the void.
